A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. Only upper left panel 033 needs editing. Adjust the existing blue-polo father's anatomy and size while keeping all six actors standing in a SINGLE plane at the blue front door. Dan is a tall, broad shouldered 42-year-old adult dad with long adult legs. Dan is visibly the tallest in the group. Leo, the 12-year-old in orange next to him, reaches roughly Dan's shoulder. Dan has adult character proportions matching original lineup reference; keep the two adult women full height and the younger children appropriately smaller. Do not enlarge Dan's head relative to his whole body or move Dan nearer the camera. Keep their feet on the same porch plane with believable contact. Dan in blue, Maya in plum at the doorknob, Nina in teal holding the single phone, Leo in orange, Ella with two braids and full denim overalls, little Max in green. Preserve precisely the BLUE front door, single blue bow fixed to door, separate brass 14 plaque on the left, one SMALL cream pennant hanging beside the door on the right, black bell right. Use same lighting; do not introduce backpacks, extra doors, overhead signs or extra people. Keep 034–036 unchanged.
